Assess every pseudobulk comparison end to end

Source: R/assessAll.R
assessAll.Rd

The main entry point. Runs the pipeline on a single-cell dataset: pbSetup() -> assessDesign() -> assessPseudobulk() -> estimateVariance() -> estimateSensitivity() -> callComparisons(), and returns the comparison table with an Adequate / Underpowered / Caution / Invalid call per cluster-by-contrast comparison.

Usage

assessAll(
  sce,
  sample,
  group,
  annotations,
  covariates = character(0),
  contrasts = NULL,
  minCells = 10,
  aggregation = c("sum", "mean"),
  assayName = "counts",
  method = c("edgeR", "deseq2", "voom"),
  targetLFC = 1,
  power = 0.8,
  fdr = 0.05,
  pi1 = "discoveries",
  alphaFixed = NULL,
  thresholds = defaultThresholds(),
  thetaReps = 3,
  BPPARAM = BiocParallel::SerialParam()
)

Arguments

sce

A SingleCellExperiment::SingleCellExperiment or SummarizedExperiment with a raw-count assay (non-negative integers).

sample

Character scalar; colData column giving the biological sample (donor) each cell belongs to.

group

Character scalar; colData column giving the condition compared.

annotations

Character vector of colData columns, each a clustering (annotation level) to pseudobulk, e.g. c("cell_type_broad").

covariates

Character vector of colData columns to carry as candidate confounders. Default none.

contrasts

Optional list of length-2 character vectors c(A, B) naming group levels to compare (B vs A). Default NULL: all non-reference levels versus the first level.

minCells

Integer; pseudobulks with fewer contributing cells are dropped. Default 10.

aggregation

Either "sum" (counts, for the negative-binomial model) or "mean" (reserved for the limma path). Default "sum".

assayName

Name of the raw-count assay in sce. Default "counts".

method

DE method whose variance model the call should match, passed to estimateVariance(): "edgeR", "deseq2" or "voom". "edgeR"/"deseq2" require aggregation = "sum"; aggregation = "mean" requires "voom".

targetLFC

Primary target absolute log2 fold-change driving the call.

power, fdr, pi1, alphaFixed

Sensitivity settings passed to estimateSensitivity().

thresholds

A list from defaultThresholds().

thetaReps

Subsample repeats for the cell-level theta fit, passed to pbSetup(); 0 skips it (the call is unchanged, the variance decomposition is NA).

BPPARAM

A BiocParallelParam object for the per-cluster theta estimation. Default BiocParallel::SerialParam().

Value

A S4Vectors::DataFrame, one row per comparison, with the metrics, the call and a reason. The pbSetup() object is attached as attr(, "pb") for inspection.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
res <- assessAll(sce, sample = "donor", group = "condition",
                 annotations = "cell_type")
table(res$call)
} # }
